title: Security Best Practices
learning_outcomes: Explain the concepts and vocabulary in Security Best Practices.
Apply an Express.js 5 pattern from Security Best Practices in a focused local example.
Verify normal behavior and at least one error or boundary case using a repeatable test.

overview_visual.alt_text: Four-step original visual for module 14, Security Best Practices: The Express.js Security Model, Secure Application Configuration, HTTP Security Headers and Helmet, HTTPS and Transport Security; then continue with practice and verification.

status_note: Syllabus outline follows the attached ExpressJS.pdf. Individual lesson code and claims require technical review and local verification before publication.
